description: Extend the ui-mockup-generation skill with the grounded-flow recipe from the research. When a decision concerns modification of an existing Vrooli page, the skill invokes BAS to capture the current-state screenshot, passes it as a reference image to the swarm-manager image generate helper with input_fidelity='high', and uses the prompt framing validated in research to minimize layout drift. Skills must detect when grounding is applicable (decision context mentions an existing page) vs not (greenfield UI). Automated test uses fixture-based playback of BAS + a mocked image CLI to verify the grounded path fires on the right decisions.
name: bas-grounded-mockup-integration
title: Wire BAS-grounded mockup flow into the skill
